subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now and use this doctor migration as the supported upgrade path?
rationale: The code can mechanically preserve the previous no-export outcome, but deciding to remove a shipped config value and potentially disable telemetry is an upgrade-policy choice that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve rejection and migration
options.body: Merge the current approach so new configs reject `grpc` and doctor repairs existing configs while preserving stdout-only logging.

options.title: Keep the shipped value temporarily
options.body: Continue accepting `grpc` with an actionable warning until a later deprecation window or migration policy is approved.

options.title: Implement gRPC export
options.body: Preserve the existing contract by adding a real gRPC exporter path, which substantially expands this PR's scope.

recommendation.title: Approve rejection and migration
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach so new configs reject `grpc` and doctor repairs existing configs while preserving stdout-only logging.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice primarily concerns core config validation and doctor migration policy, where recent repository history most strongly points.
